tools.name: studio_create_project
tools.description: Creates an anonymous project and returns the Studio link for the person plus an agent token for later edits. In one call it can start from a template (studio_list_templates), a guide example (studio_list_examples) or your own actions (studio_get_guide); aspect "9:16" makes a vertical Short.

tools.name: studio_join_project
tools.description: Consumes a five-minute one-time pairing code shown by Studio.

tools.name: studio_list_capabilities
tools.description: Lists the live action registry. Call this before preparing or modifying a project.

tools.name: studio_describe_capabilities
tools.description: Returns schemas and examples for one or more Studio actions.

tools.name: studio_get_project_summary
tools.description: Reads the current revision and a compact timeline summary. Set includeProject only when complete raw data is needed.

tools.name: studio_apply_actions
tools.description: Atomically applies one or more registered actions. Non-conflicting stale edits are rebased; conflicting edits are rejected.

tools.name: studio_validate_project
tools.description: Checks entity, track, clip, timing, and reference integrity.

tools.name: studio_get_guide
tools.description: Everything needed to build a story in one read: the fastest paths, how pieces combine (frame, shapes, move, mark, say, link, data, look), a complete example and the actions with their schemas. Read it once before building from scratch.

tools.name: studio_list_templates
tools.description: Ready-made stories to fill in (a trip with stops, visited countries, an invasion, a growing empire, World War I and II, data maps, breaking news…). Pass one to studio_create_project as template { id, values }; values not given keep the defaults shown.

tools.name: studio_list_examples
tools.description: Finished stories from the guides (a wildfire spreading, the euro year by year, a bar chart race, a war map, a train trip…). Start from one with studio_create_project example, then adapt places, texts and numbers with studio_apply_actions.

tools.name: studio_find_places
tools.description: Real coordinates for cities, towns and landmarks ([lat, lng], from OpenStreetMap) and the countries Studio can draw (with isoA2). Use it instead of guessing coordinates.

tools.name: studio_request_preview
tools.description: Asks an open Studio browser to render a frame locally.

tools.name: studio_request_export
tools.description: Asks an open Studio browser to render and download the video locally.

tools.name: studio_get_job
tools.description: Checks a local browser preview/export request.

tools.name: studio_export_json
tools.description: Returns the portable .amtstudio.json content without collaboration secrets.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "studio_export_json" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Returns the portable .amtstudio.json content without collaboration secrets.
